newsitem.title: UK: Rubicon warns on H2 sales, full-yr profits.
newsitem.headline: Rubicon warns on H2 sales, full-yr profits.

text.p: British engineer Rubicon Group Plc said on Thursday its sales and trading outlook had deteriorated and its profit for the year to May 31 would therefore fall well below market expectations.

"As a result of a slowdown in orders in certain parts of the group it is lowering its sales projections for the second half of its financial year. Accordingly it is evident that profit for the year ending 31 May, 1997 will be substantially below market expectations," Rubicon said in a statement.
However, the board said it was confident about prospects for the next financial year and it was determined that an ongoing rationalisation programme would bring improved earnings.
It therefore intended "to continue with a progressive dividend policy", it added.
By 0810 GMT, the company's shares were indicated sharply lower ahead of the full market opening, though no trading volume was recorded. The price was marked down 37-1/2p to 130p.
